lines.text: Search pages: reads from Notion, changes nothing.
Write a page: writes in Notion.
Write a page: can act on several at once.
Write a page: a Card's "Only for" can name which parent page it acts on.
Write a page: if an answer is lost, KIFF can't check whether it happened, so it stays counted.
Notion's server isn't pinned to a version, so KIFF checks it daily.
